text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins—the prime time for Umamusume to improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Taiki Shuttle, summer camp is an extreme affair, with grueling training during the day and pillow fights at night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She talks big, convinced she'll make history as the first sprinter to become Umamusume of the Year. However, her words are far from empty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us vow to work hand in hand to make our stay at the camp a success.
